leagueConstants: Previous full season, frozen v4 estimator; no 2025-26 calibration.
rookieAbility: Mean previous-season cards and B1 coefficients for same-position players with MPG<10. No NBA previous sample means role prior, including nonrookie returnees.
availability: Per-game Bernoulli: previous GP shrunk by20 games toward previous same MPG-bin mean GP/82. Unknown players use prior MPG10–20 availability. All listed non-two-way inactive players miss first14 games; fixed known/scenario exceptions below. Independent absence draws, not later injury observations.
rotation: At most12 available players, ranked by previous MPG (unknown12, two-way weight capped5); retain at least8 via rank fallback excluding predetermined inactive. Starter positions chosen from these players to minimize position distance then favor MPG. Existing frozen soft minute targets normalized to240; no observed future seconds.
